title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 双手捧稳的双层汉堡
description: 明亮的快餐店里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白色翻领衬衫和裙装坐在桌旁，双手分别托住双层芝士汉堡的两侧，小心张口咬下一口。她的碧绿眼睛专注地看着汉堡，脸颊微微鼓起，金色盘发上的蓝丝带整齐垂落。桌上是素色纸托盘与一杯饮料，大片窗光照亮她满足的神情。
action: 双手托住双层汉堡两侧，微微前倾咬下一口，目光落在食物上。
camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
promptProse: A double cheeseburger nearly fills both of Artoria Pendragon’s hands as she leans forward for a bite at a fast-food table. The knight from Fate/stay night wears a dark-blue knit cardigan over a white collared shirt and skirt. Her green eyes follow the food, cheeks gently rounded; a blue ribbon secures her blonde braided bun beneath an upright ahoge. Broad window light reaches her pleased face and a plain paper tray with one drink. Frame one seated diner at table height, no lettering.

title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 午后洗衣房的整齐衣角
description: 午后的自助洗衣房里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝开衫、白衬衫和裙装，坐在折衣台旁的矮凳上。膝前的竹篮盛着刚洗好的衣物，她双手捏住一条白毛巾的两角，在台面上把毛巾对折，碧绿眼睛认真检查边缘是否齐整。背后的滚筒洗衣机排成一列，窗外日光映亮她的金色盘发与蓝丝带，神情专注而放松。
location: 午后自助洗衣房折衣台旁
action: 坐在矮凳上，双手捏住白毛巾两角，在台面上对折并对齐边缘。
camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
promptProse: At a laundromat folding counter, Artoria Pendragon aligns the corners of a white towel with both hands. Sitting on a low stool in her dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt, the Fate/stay night knight studies the fold with attentive green eyes. A wicker laundry basket waits near her knees, with closed washing machines receding behind her. Afternoon daylight lights the blonde braided bun, blue ribbon and ahoge. Show one relaxed customer, the towel resting on the counter, no writing.

title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 银杏长椅边的热茶
description: 秋日公园的银杏叶落在木长椅旁，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝针织开衫、白衬衫和裙装坐在椅上，双膝自然并拢。她用双手捧住一只暖茶纸杯，轻轻低头靠近杯口，闻到茶香时露出很浅的笑。金色盘发上的蓝丝带随微风轻动，碧绿眼睛映着透过黄叶的斜阳；落叶小路在身后延伸。
location: 秋日公园银杏树下的木长椅
action: 双膝并拢坐在长椅上，两手捧暖茶纸杯，低头闻茶香。
camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
promptProse: Beneath yellow ginkgo leaves, a warm paper cup rests between Artoria Pendragon’s palms. Seated on a park bench with knees together, the Fate/stay night knight lowers her face toward the tea and smiles at its aroma. A dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt replace her armor. Her green eyes catch the afternoon light; a blue ribbon moves beside the blonde braided bun and ahoge. The leaf-covered path recedes behind this single seated figure. Keep the cup unmarked and the hands visible.
